Create an entry when you run a search, while the exact query, platform and result count are available. Keep each changed strategy and export linked to its own run.


<details class="template-copy">
<summary>Open the blank copyable template</summary>

Copy this plain-text version into your approved project record. Repeat entry fields as needed and remove prompts that do not apply. The guidance and examples below help you complete it.

```text
Search log

Blank register

ID: S-001
Source/database: [ ]
Platform: [ ]
Exact date: [ ]
Strategy version: [link]
Limits: [and justification]
Results: [n]
Export file: [ ]
Notes/change reason: [ ]

Review purpose and protocol: [ ]
Deduplication batch and result: [ ]
Supplementary methods: [ ]
Update and stopping rule: [ ]
```

</details>

## Check your record

Open the saved strategy and export from the log. They should identify what you ran and retained, even when the live database later changes.

## Scenario test

When results differ after an update, the exact strategy version and export allow the team to distinguish database change from an undocumented search change.
